description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git branch name interpretation and behavior of corner cases involving special branch name syntax like @{-1} and @{upstream}. It includes setup steps, test cases, and assertions to verify Git's handling of these scenarios.

methods.name: expect_branch
methods.description: Verifies that the latest git log message for a given branch matches an expected value.

methods.name: expect_deleted
methods.description: Checks that a git rev-parse command fails for a given branch, indicating it has been deleted or does not exist.
